source_books.title: The Great Mental Models Volume 1: General Thinking Concepts
source_books.author: Shane Parrish, Rhiannon Beaubien

questions_en: Which beliefs about this task are conventions rather than facts?
What are the irreducible components, constraints and their real costs?
What solution emerges if we rebuild only from those components?
questions_ar: ما المعتقدات في هذه المهمة التي هي أعراف وليست حقائق؟
ما المكونات والقيود غير القابلة للاختزال وما تكلفتها الحقيقية؟
ما الحل الذي يظهر إذا أعدنا البناء من هذه المكونات فقط؟
frameworks.output: list of assumptions split into facts vs conventions plus a rebuilt solution sketch from the facts only
frameworks.check: at least 5 assumptions classified, each fact has a cited source or measurement, and the sketch uses no item marked convention
frameworks.anti_pattern: declaring something a first principle without evidence, or reinventing what already works for no gain

source_books.title: The Great Mental Models Volume 1: General Thinking Concepts
source_books.author: Shane Parrish, Rhiannon Beaubien

source_books.title: Poor Charlie's Almanack
source_books.author: Peter D. Kaufman (ed.), Charles T. Munger

questions_en: What would guarantee this task fails?
Which of those failure causes are we currently doing or at risk of doing?
What rules prevent each failure cause?
questions_ar: ما الذي يضمن فشل هذه المهمة؟
أي من أسباب الفشل هذه نفعلها حالياً أو معرضون لها؟
ما القواعد التي تمنع كل سبب فشل؟
frameworks.output: list of failure causes, each mapped to a 'never do' rule and a current-status flag
frameworks.check: at least 6 failure causes, every cause has exactly one prevention rule, and every rule is testable as yes/no
frameworks.anti_pattern: stopping at the list of fears without converting them into concrete avoidance rules

source_books.title: The Great Mental Models Volume 1: General Thinking Concepts
source_books.author: Shane Parrish, Rhiannon Beaubien

questions_en: What happens immediately if we do this?
And then what happens next, for each stakeholder, after weeks and after a year?
Which delayed effect reverses or outweighs the first-order benefit?
questions_ar: ماذا يحدث فوراً إذا فعلنا هذا؟
ثم ماذا يحدث بعد ذلك لكل طرف بعد أسابيع وبعد سنة؟
أي أثر متأخر يعكس الفائدة الأولى أو يفوقها؟
frameworks.output: consequence chain table: action -> 1st-order -> 2nd-order -> 3rd-order effects per stakeholder
frameworks.check: at least 3 stakeholders with at least 2 levels of effects each, and at least one negative delayed effect identified or explicitly ruled out
frameworks.anti_pattern: speculating endlessly into unlikely chains instead of the few probable, material ones

source_books.title: Cynefin: Weaving Sense-Making into the Fabric of Our World
source_books.author: Dave Snowden

questions_en: Is the cause-effect relationship obvious, knowable by analysis, only visible in hindsight, or absent?
Which parts of the task belong to which domain?
Which response fits each part: best practice, expert analysis, safe-to-fail probes, or act-first stabilisation?
questions_ar: هل العلاقة بين السبب والنتيجة واضحة أم تُعرف بالتحليل أم تظهر بعد حدوثها فقط أم غائبة؟
أي أجزاء المهمة تنتمي لأي مجال؟
ما الاستجابة المناسبة لكل جزء: أفضل ممارسة أم تحليل خبير أم تجارب آمنة الفشل أم تصرف فوري للتثبيت؟
frameworks.output: domain classification of each sub-problem (clear/complicated/complex/chaotic/confused) with the matching response mode
frameworks.check: every sub-problem has exactly one domain and a response verb (sense-categorise-respond, sense-analyse-respond, probe-sense-respond, act-sense-respond)
frameworks.anti_pattern: forcing complex problems into best-practice plans, or using the framework as a 2x2 label without changing the approach

questions_en: What is the problem as stated, and who stated it?
What else could the real problem be (look outside the frame, rethink the goal, examine bright spots, look in the mirror)?
Which reframe changes what we would build?
questions_ar: ما المشكلة كما طُرحت ومن طرحها؟
ما الذي قد تكون عليه المشكلة الحقيقية (خارج الإطار، إعادة التفكير في الهدف، النقاط المضيئة، النظر لأنفسنا)؟
أي صياغة جديدة تغير ما سنبنيه؟
frameworks.output: original problem statement plus 3-5 alternative framings, with the selected framing and why
frameworks.check: at least 3 alternative framings that each imply a different solution, and the chosen one is confirmed by the request owner or evidence
frameworks.anti_pattern: reframing forever as procrastination, or reframing away the user's explicit request

source_books.title: Toyota Production System: Beyond Large-Scale Production
source_books.author: Taiichi Ohno

questions_en: What exactly is the observed symptom?
Why did it happen, and why did that happen, until we reach a cause we can control?
What countermeasure addresses the deepest controllable cause?
questions_ar: ما العَرَض المرصود بالضبط؟
لماذا حدث، ولماذا حدث ذلك، حتى نصل إلى سبب يمكننا التحكم فيه؟
ما الإجراء المضاد الذي يعالج أعمق سبب قابل للتحكم؟
frameworks.output: why-chain from symptom to root cause with evidence at each link and one countermeasure
frameworks.check: each link cites evidence (log, measurement, observation), the chain ends at a process-level cause, and the countermeasure would have prevented the original symptom
frameworks.anti_pattern: stopping at 'human error' or following a single linear chain when multiple causes exist

questions_en: What is the effect (problem) at the head of the diagram?
What candidate causes exist in each category (methods, machines, materials, people, measurement, environment)?
Which candidate causes are supported by data?
questions_ar: ما الأثر (المشكلة) في رأس المخطط؟
ما الأسباب المحتملة في كل فئة (الطرق، الآلات، المواد، الأشخاص، القياس، البيئة)؟
أي الأسباب المحتملة تدعمها البيانات؟
frameworks.output: cause-and-effect diagram with categorised candidate causes, top suspects marked for verification
frameworks.check: at least 4 categories populated with at least 2 causes each, and top 3 suspects each have a verification test
frameworks.anti_pattern: treating the brainstormed causes as proven without checking data

questions_en: What is the single key question at the root?
How does it split into branches that are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive?
Which branches matter most and can be analysed first?
questions_ar: ما السؤال الرئيسي الواحد في الجذر؟
كيف يتفرع إلى فروع متنافية وشاملة معاً؟
أي الفروع أهم ويمكن تحليلها أولاً؟
frameworks.output: issue tree of 2-3 levels with prioritised branches and an analysis owner per leaf
frameworks.check: no two sibling branches overlap, siblings sum to the parent, and every leaf is answerable with a named analysis
frameworks.anti_pattern: building a beautiful tree that is never pruned or prioritised

source_books.title: The McKinsey Mind
source_books.author: Ethan M. Rasiel, Paul N. Friga

questions_en: What is our best initial answer to the question right now?
What would have to be true for that answer to hold?
Which analysis would most quickly prove or kill it?
questions_ar: ما أفضل إجابة أولية لدينا على السؤال الآن؟
ما الذي يجب أن يكون صحيحاً لكي تصمد هذه الإجابة؟
أي تحليل يثبتها أو يسقطها بأسرع شكل؟
frameworks.output: initial hypothesis with its supporting conditions and a ranked list of disconfirming analyses
frameworks.check: hypothesis is falsifiable, at least 3 conditions listed, and each condition has a test with a pass/fail threshold
frameworks.anti_pattern: anchoring on the first hypothesis and only seeking confirming data

source_books.title: The Great Mental Models Volume 1: General Thinking Concepts
source_books.author: Shane Parrish, Rhiannon Beaubien

questions_en: Which parts of this task are inside our proven competence?
Which parts are at the edge or outside it?
Who or what can cover the parts outside the circle?
questions_ar: أي أجزاء المهمة تقع داخل كفاءتنا المثبتة؟
أي أجزاء على الحافة أو خارجها؟
من أو ما الذي يمكنه تغطية الأجزاء خارج الدائرة؟
frameworks.output: map of task parts labelled inside/edge/outside competence with a coverage plan for edge and outside parts
frameworks.check: every part labelled with evidence of past success for 'inside', and every 'outside' part has a named expert, tool or learning step
frameworks.anti_pattern: overestimating the circle, or refusing all work outside it instead of borrowing competence

frameworks.name_en: The Map Is Not the Territory

source_books.title: The Great Mental Models Volume 1: General Thinking Concepts
source_books.author: Shane Parrish, Rhiannon Beaubien

questions_en: Which models, metrics or documents are we relying on?
Where might they diverge from reality on the ground?
How can we check the territory directly?
questions_ar: ما النماذج أو المقاييس أو الوثائق التي نعتمد عليها؟
أين قد تختلف عن الواقع الفعلي؟
كيف نتحقق من الواقع مباشرة؟
frameworks.output: list of models/proxies in use with their known blind spots and a direct-observation check for each
frameworks.check: each proxy has at least one stated limitation and one ground-truth check that was actually performed or scheduled
frameworks.anti_pattern: discarding all models as 'just maps' instead of using them with stated limits

source_books.title: The Great Mental Models Volume 1: General Thinking Concepts
source_books.author: Shane Parrish, Rhiannon Beaubien

questions_en: What competing explanations fit the evidence?
Which explanation needs the fewest unsupported assumptions?
What evidence would force us to the more complex explanation?
questions_ar: ما التفسيرات المتنافسة التي تتوافق مع الأدلة؟
أي تفسير يحتاج أقل عدد من الافتراضات غير المدعومة؟
ما الدليل الذي سيجبرنا على التفسير الأكثر تعقيداً؟
frameworks.output: ranked list of explanations by number of unsupported assumptions, with the leading one and its upgrade trigger
frameworks.check: at least 3 explanations, assumption count stated for each, and a concrete observation named that would overturn the simplest
frameworks.anti_pattern: using simplicity as proof, ignoring evidence that demands a richer explanation

frameworks.name_en: Strategy Kernel (Diagnosis, Guiding Policy, Coherent Actions)
frameworks.name_ar: نواة الاستراتيجية (التشخيص، السياسة الموجهة، الأفعال المتسقة)
questions_en: What is the diagnosis of the critical challenge?
What guiding policy addresses that challenge?
Which coherent, mutually reinforcing actions carry out the policy?
questions_ar: ما تشخيص التحدي الحرج؟
ما السياسة الموجهة التي تعالج هذا التحدي؟
ما الأفعال المتسقة والمتعاضدة التي تنفذ هذه السياسة؟
frameworks.output: one-page strategy kernel: diagnosis paragraph, guiding policy sentence, 3-5 coherent actions
frameworks.check: the diagnosis names a specific obstacle, the policy rules options out, and every action traces to the policy
frameworks.anti_pattern: writing goals or slogans ('be the best') and calling them strategy

source_books.title: The Fifth Discipline Fieldbook
source_books.author: Peter M. Senge, Art Kleiner, Charlotte Roberts, Richard Ross, Bryan Smith

questions_en: What observable data did we start from?
Which meanings and assumptions did we add on the way to the conclusion?
Which rung should we test or revisit?
questions_ar: ما البيانات المرصودة التي انطلقنا منها؟
ما المعاني والافتراضات التي أضفناها في الطريق إلى الاستنتاج؟
أي درجة يجب أن نختبرها أو نراجعها؟
frameworks.output: ladder trace from observed data through interpretations to conclusion, with flagged untested rungs
frameworks.check: each rung is written explicitly, at least one assumption is tested against raw data, and the conclusion is kept or revised accordingly
frameworks.anti_pattern: using the ladder to dismiss other people's views while not examining one's own

questions_en: What are the facts and missing information (white), feelings (red), and risks (black)?
What are the benefits (yellow) and new alternatives (green)?
What is the process summary and next step (blue)?
questions_ar: ما الحقائق والمعلومات الناقصة (الأبيض) والمشاعر (الأحمر) والمخاطر (الأسود)؟
ما الفوائد (الأصفر) والبدائل الجديدة (الأخضر)؟
ما ملخص العملية والخطوة التالية (الأزرق)؟
frameworks.output: six-section note with entries under each hat and a blue-hat decision on next step
frameworks.check: all six hats have at least 2 entries and the blue-hat section names one next action
frameworks.anti_pattern: letting one hat (usually black) dominate or using hats to label people instead of modes

questions_en: What could we substitute, combine or adapt?
What could we modify/magnify, put to another use, or eliminate?
What could we reverse or rearrange?
questions_ar: ما الذي يمكن استبداله أو دمجه أو تكييفه؟
ما الذي يمكن تعديله أو تكبيره أو استخدامه لغرض آخر أو حذفه؟
ما الذي يمكن عكسه أو إعادة ترتيبه؟
frameworks.output: idea list with at least one idea per SCAMPER verb, tagged by verb
frameworks.check: all 7 verbs covered with at least 1 idea each and at least 14 ideas total before any filtering
frameworks.anti_pattern: judging ideas during generation or applying only the easy verbs

questions_en: Which parameter improves while another worsens (the contradiction)?
What would the ideal final result be, with the function delivered and no cost?
Which inventive principles (e.g. segmentation, prior action, inversion) resolve the contradiction?
questions_ar: أي معيار يتحسن بينما يسوء آخر (التناقض)؟
ما النتيجة النهائية المثالية التي تؤدي الوظيفة بلا تكلفة؟
أي مبادئ إبداعية (مثل التجزئة، الفعل المسبق، العكس) تحل التناقض؟
frameworks.output: contradiction statement, ideal final result, and concept options each linked to a named inventive principle
frameworks.check: contradiction states both parameters, at least 3 principles applied, and each concept removes the trade-off rather than compromising
frameworks.anti_pattern: settling for a compromise and calling it a TRIZ solution, or forcing the matrix on non-technical problems

source_books.title: Lateral Thinking: Creativity Step by Step
source_books.author: Edward de Bono

questions_en: What dominant idea or assumption controls current thinking about this task?
What alternatives emerge if we challenge it or enter from a different point?
Which alternative is worth moving forward?
questions_ar: ما الفكرة أو الافتراض المسيطر على التفكير الحالي في المهمة؟
ما البدائل التي تظهر إذا تحديناها أو دخلنا من نقطة مختلفة؟
أي بديل يستحق المضي به؟
frameworks.output: named dominant idea plus a list of alternative entry points and the ideas they produced
frameworks.check: dominant idea explicitly stated, at least 5 alternatives, and at least 2 not reachable by incremental tweaks
frameworks.anti_pattern: producing random novelty with no link back to the task goal

questions_en: How many ideas can we generate with judgement deferred?
What wild ideas push beyond the obvious?
How can ideas be combined and built upon?
questions_ar: كم فكرة يمكننا توليدها مع تأجيل الحكم؟
ما الأفكار الجامحة التي تتجاوز المألوف؟
كيف يمكن دمج الأفكار والبناء عليها؟
frameworks.output: unfiltered numbered list of ideas with combined/built-on ideas marked
frameworks.check: at least 20 ideas recorded before evaluation, at least 3 marked wild, at least 3 combinations
frameworks.anti_pattern: criticising during generation or stopping at the first ten obvious ideas

questions_en: What insight or pain point are we starting from?
How might we phrase it as an opportunity that is neither too broad nor too narrow?
Which HMW questions open the most promising solution space?
questions_ar: ما الرؤية أو نقطة الألم التي ننطلق منها؟
كيف يمكننا صياغتها كفرصة ليست واسعة جداً ولا ضيقة جداً؟
أي أسئلة "كيف يمكننا" تفتح أكثر مساحة حلول واعدة؟
frameworks.output: set of 5-10 'How might we...' questions derived from insights, with 2-3 selected
frameworks.check: each HMW traces to a stated insight, contains no embedded solution, and selected ones each yield at least 3 ideas
frameworks.anti_pattern: writing HMWs that smuggle in a solution or are so broad they guide nothing

questions_en: Why does this situation exist as it does?
What if we changed a core element?
How could we try the most promising 'what if' in practice?
questions_ar: لماذا يوجد هذا الوضع على ما هو عليه؟
ماذا لو غيرنا عنصراً جوهرياً؟
كيف نجرب أكثر "ماذا لو" واعدة عملياً؟
frameworks.output: question ladder: why-questions, what-if-questions, and how-questions with one chosen experiment
frameworks.check: at least 3 questions per stage and the chosen how-question names a concrete first test
frameworks.anti_pattern: asking clever questions without ever moving to the 'how' stage

source_books.title: Discovery, Invention, Research Through the Morphological Approach
source_books.author: Fritz Zwicky

questions_en: What independent dimensions define a solution?
What options exist along each dimension?
Which combinations are novel and consistent?
questions_ar: ما الأبعاد المستقلة التي تحدد الحل؟
ما الخيارات المتاحة على كل بعد؟
أي التركيبات جديدة ومتسقة؟
frameworks.output: morphological box (dimensions x options) and a shortlist of consistent novel combinations
frameworks.check: at least 4 dimensions with at least 3 options each, incompatible pairs marked, and at least 3 consistent combinations shortlisted
frameworks.anti_pattern: enumerating thousands of combinations without a consistency filter

questions_en: What deliberately unreasonable statement (Po) about this task can we make?
What useful idea can be extracted by moving from the provocation?
What does a random word or object suggest when connected to the task?
questions_ar: ما العبارة غير المعقولة عمداً (Po) التي يمكن قولها عن المهمة؟
ما الفكرة المفيدة التي يمكن استخراجها بالتحرك من هذا الاستفزاز؟
ماذا تقترح كلمة أو شيء عشوائي عند ربطه بالمهمة؟
frameworks.output: list of provocations and random entries, each with the practical idea extracted from it
frameworks.check: at least 3 provocations and 2 random entries, each producing a feasible idea written in plain terms
frameworks.anti_pattern: stopping at the absurd provocation instead of extracting movement value from it

questions_en: Which existing components, tools and capabilities are already available to us?
What new things become possible one step away by combining them?
Which slow hunches or partial ideas can be connected now?
questions_ar: ما المكونات والأدوات والقدرات المتاحة لنا فعلاً؟
ما الأشياء الجديدة التي تصبح ممكنة على بعد خطوة بدمجها؟
أي حدس بطيء أو أفكار جزئية يمكن ربطها الآن؟
frameworks.output: inventory of available building blocks and a list of one-step-away combinations
frameworks.check: at least 8 building blocks listed and at least 3 combinations that require no unavailable component
frameworks.anti_pattern: jumping to ideas that need several missing breakthroughs

book_evidence.title: Where Good Ideas Come From: The Natural History of Innovation

questions_en: Which unrelated fields have solved a structurally similar problem?
What concept from each field could be transplanted here?
Which intersection produces an idea no single field would?
questions_ar: ما المجالات غير المرتبطة التي حلت مشكلة مشابهة بنيوياً؟
ما المفهوم من كل مجال الذي يمكن نقله إلى هنا؟
أي تقاطع ينتج فكرة لا ينتجها مجال واحد وحده؟
frameworks.output: list of source fields, transplanted concepts and resulting intersectional ideas
frameworks.check: at least 3 distinct fields, each concept adapted with a stated mapping, at least 1 idea combining 2 fields
frameworks.anti_pattern: superficial metaphors with no structural mapping to the task

source_books.title: Synectics: The Development of Creative Capacity
source_books.author: William J. J. Gordon

questions_en: How can we make the familiar strange through direct, personal, symbolic or fantasy analogy?
What would it feel like to be the object or system?
Which analogy yields a workable concept when forced back onto the task?
questions_ar: كيف نجعل المألوف غريباً عبر تشبيه مباشر أو شخصي أو رمزي أو خيالي؟
كيف سيكون الشعور لو كنا الشيء أو النظام نفسه؟
أي تشبيه ينتج مفهوماً قابلاً للتطبيق عند إسقاطه على المهمة؟
frameworks.output: analogy set (by type) and the force-fit concepts derived from them
frameworks.check: at least one analogy of each of the 4 types and at least 2 force-fit concepts with a feasibility note
frameworks.anti_pattern: enjoying the metaphors without the force-fit step back to a solution

questions_en: What is the central topic?
What main branches and sub-branches radiate from it?
Which cross-links between branches reveal new ideas?
questions_ar: ما الموضوع المركزي؟
ما الفروع الرئيسية والفرعية المنبثقة منه؟
أي روابط بين الفروع تكشف أفكاراً جديدة؟
frameworks.output: radial mind map (as nested outline or graph) with cross-links highlighted
frameworks.check: at least 5 main branches, at least 2 levels deep, and at least 2 cross-links annotated
frameworks.anti_pattern: turning the map into a linear list and losing the associations

source_books.title: This Is Service Design Doing
source_books.author: Marc Stickdorn, Markus Edgar Hormess, Adam Lawrence, Jakob Schneider

questions_en: Have we diverged to discover the problem space before defining it?
What single problem definition closes the first diamond?
Have we explored multiple solutions before converging on delivery?
questions_ar: هل توسعنا لاكتشاف مساحة المشكلة قبل تعريفها؟
ما تعريف المشكلة الواحد الذي يغلق الماسة الأولى؟
هل استكشفنا حلولاً متعددة قبل التقارب على التسليم؟
frameworks.output: four-phase plan (discover, define, develop, deliver) with outputs and a gate between each
frameworks.check: each phase has a named artifact, the define gate yields one problem statement, and develop shows at least 3 candidate solutions
frameworks.anti_pattern: running it as a linear waterfall or skipping the first diamond

questions_en: Which few inputs drive most of the outcome?
What does the measured distribution actually look like?
What would we stop doing if we focused on the vital few?
questions_ar: ما المدخلات القليلة التي تقود معظم النتيجة؟
كيف يبدو التوزيع المقاس فعلياً؟
ما الذي سنتوقف عنه إذا ركزنا على القلة الحيوية؟
frameworks.output: ranked contribution table with cumulative percentage and the vital-few cut line
frameworks.check: table built from real counts, cumulative share computed, and the cut line items account for a stated majority of the effect
frameworks.anti_pattern: assuming an 80/20 split without measuring it

book_evidence.title: The 80/20 Principle: The Secret to Success by Achieving More with Less

questions_en: What raw observations do we have?
Which observations cluster naturally, bottom-up?
What theme label and insight does each cluster express?
questions_ar: ما الملاحظات الخام المتوفرة لدينا؟
أي الملاحظات تتجمع طبيعياً من الأسفل للأعلى؟
ما عنوان المحور والرؤية التي يعبر عنها كل تجمع؟
frameworks.output: clustered observations under labelled themes with one insight statement per theme
frameworks.check: every observation assigned to exactly one cluster or an 'unassigned' bin, each cluster has at least 3 items and an insight sentence
frameworks.anti_pattern: starting with predefined categories and forcing data into them

source_books.title: Gamestorming
source_books.author: Dave Gray, Sunni Brown, James Macanufo

questions_en: Which options are on the board and what criterion are we voting on?
How many votes does each participant get?
Which options rise to the top, and is the result a decision or an input?
questions_ar: ما الخيارات المطروحة وما المعيار الذي نصوت عليه؟
كم صوتاً لكل مشارك؟
أي الخيارات تتصدر، وهل النتيجة قرار أم مُدخل؟
frameworks.output: vote tally per option against a stated criterion with the top-N shortlist
frameworks.check: criterion written before voting, total votes equal participants x allowance, top-N listed with counts
frameworks.anti_pattern: treating a popularity count as a final decision on high-stakes questions

questions_en: Which concept is the datum (baseline)?
How does each alternative score better, same or worse on each criterion?
Which hybrid combines the strengths found?
questions_ar: أي مفهوم هو المرجع (خط الأساس)؟
كيف يقارن كل بديل: أفضل أو مساوٍ أو أسوأ على كل معيار؟
أي مزيج يجمع نقاط القوة المكتشفة؟
frameworks.output: criteria x concepts matrix with +/S/- scores versus a datum and a recommended or hybrid concept
frameworks.check: at least 5 criteria and 3 concepts, every cell scored, totals computed, and the recommendation follows from the totals or explains the override
frameworks.anti_pattern: weighting criteria after seeing the scores to justify a favourite

source_books.title: Group Techniques for Program Planning
source_books.author: Andre L. Delbecq, Andrew H. Van de Ven, David H. Gustafson

questions_en: What ideas does each member generate silently and independently?
What clarifications are needed after round-robin sharing?
How do private rankings aggregate?
questions_ar: ما الأفكار التي يولدها كل عضو بصمت وباستقلال؟
ما التوضيحات اللازمة بعد المشاركة الدورية؟
كيف تُجمع الترتيبات الفردية الخاصة؟
frameworks.output: aggregated ranking from independent individual rankings with the idea list
frameworks.check: each member's ideas recorded before discussion, every member submitted a ranking, and the aggregate is reproducible from the raw ranks
frameworks.anti_pattern: letting discussion start before independent generation, which re-introduces anchoring

source_books.title: The Delphi Method: Techniques and Applications
source_books.author: Harold A. Linstone, Murray Turoff

questions_en: Which independent experts should estimate?
What do anonymous first-round estimates and reasons show?
How do estimates move after controlled feedback rounds?
questions_ar: من الخبراء المستقلون الذين يجب أن يقدّروا؟
ماذا تظهر التقديرات المجهولة للجولة الأولى وأسبابها؟
كيف تتحرك التقديرات بعد جولات تغذية راجعة مضبوطة؟
frameworks.output: multi-round anonymous estimate record with median, spread and rationale per round
frameworks.check: at least 2 rounds, at least 3 independent estimators, spread reported per round, and final median stated
frameworks.anti_pattern: leaking identities so that seniority drives convergence

questions_en: What is the one thing that matters most in this task?
Which items score below 90% on our essential criteria and should be cut?
What will we explicitly say no to?
questions_ar: ما الشيء الواحد الأهم في هذه المهمة؟
أي البنود تحصل على أقل من 90% في معاييرنا الجوهرية ويجب حذفها؟
ما الذي سنرفضه صراحة؟
frameworks.output: essential-intent statement, kept list, and explicit not-doing list
frameworks.check: one essential intent sentence, kept list shorter than cut list or justified, and every cut item has a reason
frameworks.anti_pattern: using 'essentialism' to drop must-haves the user stated

book_evidence.title: Essentialism: The Disciplined Pursuit of Less

questions_en: What are the two opposing models on the table?
What does each model get right that we must keep?
What new model achieves both benefits rather than choosing one?
questions_ar: ما النموذجان المتعارضان المطروحان؟
ما الذي يصيب فيه كل نموذج ويجب أن نحتفظ به؟
ما النموذج الجديد الذي يحقق الفائدتين بدلاً من اختيار أحدهما؟
frameworks.output: description of two opposing models, their kept strengths, and an integrated third model
frameworks.check: integrated model is shown to keep at least one key benefit from each side, with a test of feasibility
frameworks.anti_pattern: averaging the two models into a mushy compromise

frameworks.name_ar: عدسة الرغبة والجدوى التقنية والجدوى التجارية
questions_en: Do users actually want this (desirability)?
Can we build it with available technology and skills (feasibility)?
Does it sustain itself economically (viability)?
questions_ar: هل يريد المستخدمون هذا فعلاً (الرغبة)؟
هل يمكننا بناؤه بالتقنية والمهارات المتاحة (الجدوى التقنية)؟
هل يستمر اقتصادياً (الجدوى التجارية)؟
frameworks.output: concept scorecard with evidence for each of the three lenses and the weakest lens flagged
frameworks.check: each lens has at least one evidence item (not opinion) and the weakest lens has a next test
frameworks.anti_pattern: scoring all three lenses from internal opinion without user or cost evidence

questions_en: Which items need to be organised?
How do users group and label them (open or closed sort)?
Which groupings are consistent across participants?
questions_ar: ما العناصر التي تحتاج إلى تنظيم؟
كيف يجمعها المستخدمون ويسمونها (فرز مفتوح أو مغلق)؟
أي التجميعات متسقة بين المشاركين؟
frameworks.output: category structure derived from participant sorts with agreement percentages
frameworks.check: at least 5 participants or a stated proxy, agreement computed per item, and items below threshold flagged
frameworks.anti_pattern: designing the taxonomy from the org chart instead of user mental models

questions_en: How many options are we presenting to the user or decision-maker?
Which options add little distinct value and can be removed or defaulted?
What sensible default reduces choice burden?
questions_ar: كم خياراً نعرض على المستخدم أو صاحب القرار؟
أي الخيارات تضيف قيمة متمايزة قليلة ويمكن حذفها أو جعلها افتراضية؟
ما الخيار الافتراضي المعقول الذي يخفف عبء الاختيار؟
frameworks.output: reduced option set with a recommended default and rationale for each removal
frameworks.check: option count reduced or justified, exactly one default marked, and each remaining option has a distinct use case
frameworks.anti_pattern: removing options users genuinely need to differentiate

book_evidence.title: The Paradox of Choice: Why More Is Less

questions_en: What are the plus points of the idea?
What are the minus points?
What is interesting, neither good nor bad, and worth exploring?
questions_ar: ما النقاط الإيجابية في الفكرة؟
ما النقاط السلبية؟
ما المثير للاهتمام، ليس جيداً ولا سيئاً، ويستحق الاستكشاف؟
frameworks.output: three-column PMI table per idea with a resulting judgement
frameworks.check: each column has at least 2 entries and the judgement references specific entries
frameworks.anti_pattern: filling the columns to rationalise a decision already made

source_books.title: Boyd: The Fighter Pilot Who Changed the Art of War
source_books.author: Robert Coram

questions_en: What are we observing right now, from which sources?
How do our mental models and context orient our interpretation?
What decision and action can we take now, and how fast can we loop again?
questions_ar: ماذا نلاحظ الآن ومن أي مصادر؟
كيف توجه نماذجنا الذهنية وسياقنا تفسيرنا؟
ما القرار والفعل الذي يمكننا اتخاذه الآن، وبأي سرعة نعيد الحلقة؟
frameworks.output: loop record: observations, orientation notes, decision, action, and next loop time
frameworks.check: each element filled, action is executable within the stated loop time, and the next observation point is scheduled
frameworks.anti_pattern: treating it as a slow linear checklist instead of a fast adaptive cycle

questions_en: What are the possible outcomes of each option?
What probability and payoff do we assign to each outcome?
Which option has the best expected value, and can we survive its worst case?
questions_ar: ما النتائج الممكنة لكل خيار؟
ما الاحتمال والعائد الذي نعطيه لكل نتيجة؟
أي خيار له أفضل قيمة متوقعة، وهل يمكننا تحمل أسوأ حالاته؟
frameworks.output: outcome table per option with probabilities, payoffs, expected value and worst case
frameworks.check: probabilities per option sum to 1, EV computed numerically, and worst case compared against a stated survival limit
frameworks.anti_pattern: maximising EV on bets with ruinous downside

questions_en: Projecting to age 80 (or the far future), which choice would we regret not making?
Is the regret about action or inaction?
What is the cost of trying and failing versus never trying?
questions_ar: بالنظر إلى سن الثمانين (أو المستقبل البعيد)، أي اختيار سنندم على عدم اتخاذه؟
هل الندم على الفعل أم على عدم الفعل؟
ما تكلفة المحاولة والفشل مقابل عدم المحاولة أبداً؟
frameworks.output: long-horizon regret comparison per option with a chosen path and the accepted downside
frameworks.check: each option has a regret statement for both action and inaction, and the chosen path names its accepted worst case
frameworks.anti_pattern: using it to justify reckless bets while ignoring survivability

book_evidence.title: The Everything Store: Jeff Bezos and the Age of Amazon

frameworks.name_en: Reversible vs Irreversible Decisions (One-Way and Two-Way Doors)
frameworks.name_ar: القرارات القابلة وغير القابلة للعكس (الأبواب ذات الاتجاه الواحد والاتجاهين)

source_books.title: Invent and Wander: The Collected Writings of Jeff Bezos
source_books.author: Jeff Bezos

questions_en: Can this decision be undone cheaply and quickly?
If irreversible, what extra analysis and approval does it need?
If reversible, how can we decide fast and set a rollback trigger?
questions_ar: هل يمكن التراجع عن هذا القرار بسرعة وبتكلفة منخفضة؟
إذا كان غير قابل للعكس، ما التحليل والموافقة الإضافيان اللازمان؟
إذا كان قابلاً للعكس، كيف نقرر بسرعة ونحدد شرط التراجع؟
frameworks.output: list of decisions classified one-way or two-way with the matching process (fast + rollback, or deliberate + approval)
frameworks.check: every decision classified with a reversal cost estimate, every two-way door has a rollback trigger, every one-way door has an explicit approver
frameworks.anti_pattern: treating all decisions as one-way doors and slowing everything down, or vice versa

questions_en: What is our prior probability before the new evidence?
How much more likely is this evidence if the hypothesis is true than if false?
What is the posterior, and what would move it further?
questions_ar: ما الاحتمال المسبق قبل الدليل الجديد؟
بكم مرة يكون هذا الدليل أكثر احتمالاً إذا كانت الفرضية صحيحة مقارنة بخطئها؟
ما الاحتمال اللاحق، وما الذي سيحركه أكثر؟
frameworks.output: belief log with prior, likelihood ratio, posterior per evidence item
frameworks.check: prior stated numerically before evidence, each update shows the ratio, and the posterior is arithmetically consistent
frameworks.anti_pattern: overreacting to vivid single data points or never updating from a stated prior

book_evidence.title: The Signal and the Noise: Why So Many Predictions Fail - But Some Don't

frameworks.name_en: Base Rates and the Outside View
questions_en: What reference class of similar projects or cases does this belong to?
What is the base rate of outcomes (duration, cost, success) in that class?
How much should our specific case adjust from that base rate, and why?
questions_ar: ما الفئة المرجعية من المشاريع أو الحالات المشابهة التي تنتمي إليها هذه؟
ما معدل الأساس للنتائج (المدة، التكلفة، النجاح) في تلك الفئة؟
كم يجب أن تعدل حالتنا عن معدل الأساس ولماذا؟
frameworks.output: reference-class forecast: class definition, base rate with source, adjusted estimate and justification
frameworks.check: reference class has at least 5 comparable cases or a cited statistic, and adjustment is bounded and justified
frameworks.anti_pattern: picking a flattering reference class or ignoring it in favour of the inside story

book_evidence.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow

questions_en: Which of our conclusions came from fast intuition?
Is this a domain with regular feedback where intuition is reliable?
Which conclusions need slow, deliberate checking?
questions_ar: أي استنتاجاتنا جاءت من الحدس السريع؟
هل هذا مجال ذو تغذية راجعة منتظمة يكون فيه الحدس موثوقاً؟
أي الاستنتاجات تحتاج فحصاً متأنياً ومتعمداً؟
frameworks.output: list of key judgements tagged intuitive or deliberate with a validity note and the ones re-checked
frameworks.check: every key judgement tagged, intuitive ones in low-validity domains are re-derived explicitly
frameworks.anti_pattern: slowing down every trivial choice, or trusting intuition in noisy, low-feedback domains

book_evidence.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow

questions_en: How can we Widen our options beyond 'whether or not'?
How can we Reality-test our assumptions?
How do we Attain distance before deciding and Prepare to be wrong?
questions_ar: كيف نوسع خياراتنا بعيداً عن "نفعل أو لا نفعل"؟
كيف نختبر افتراضاتنا على أرض الواقع؟
كيف نأخذ مسافة قبل القرار ونستعد لاحتمال الخطأ؟
frameworks.output: decision brief covering widened options, reality tests, distancing check and tripwires
frameworks.check: at least 3 options, at least 1 reality test executed or planned, and at least 1 tripwire with a date or metric
frameworks.anti_pattern: skipping 'widen' and evaluating a single yes/no option

questions_en: What did we know and what could we have known when we decided?
Was the outcome driven by decision quality or by luck?
What would we change in the process, not just the result?
questions_ar: ماذا كنا نعرف وماذا كان يمكن أن نعرف عند اتخاذ القرار؟
هل كانت النتيجة مدفوعة بجودة القرار أم بالحظ؟
ما الذي سنغيره في العملية وليس في النتيجة فقط؟
frameworks.output: decision review separating information available, process quality, luck factors and process changes
frameworks.check: review lists information known at the time, rates process independently of outcome, and names at least 1 process change
frameworks.anti_pattern: judging decisions solely by their outcomes

source_books.title: The Rational Manager
source_books.author: Charles H. Kepner, Benjamin B. Tregoe

questions_en: What are the must criteria (pass/fail) and want criteria (weighted)?
Which alternatives pass all musts, and how do they score on wants?
What adverse consequences does the leading alternative carry?
questions_ar: ما المعايير الإلزامية (نجاح/رسوب) والمعايير المرغوبة (موزونة)؟
أي البدائل تجتاز كل الإلزاميات وكيف تُقيّم على المرغوبات؟
ما العواقب السلبية التي يحملها البديل المتصدر؟
frameworks.output: decision table with musts, weighted wants, scores per alternative and adverse-consequence analysis of the top choice
frameworks.check: musts are binary, weights set before scoring, totals computed, and top choice has at least 2 risks with probability and severity
frameworks.anti_pattern: setting weights after scoring to favour a preferred option

questions_en: What is the minimum acceptable level on each criterion?
How much search cost are we willing to spend?
Which first option meets all thresholds?
questions_ar: ما الحد الأدنى المقبول على كل معيار؟
كم من تكلفة البحث نحن مستعدون لإنفاقه؟
ما أول خيار يحقق كل الحدود؟
frameworks.output: aspiration thresholds per criterion, search budget, and the first option that satisfies them
frameworks.check: thresholds written before evaluating options, the selected option meets every threshold, and search stayed within budget
frameworks.anti_pattern: satisficing on irreversible high-stakes decisions that deserve optimisation

questions_en: How will we feel about each option in 10 minutes?
How about in 10 months?
And in 10 years?
questions_ar: كيف سنشعر تجاه كل خيار بعد 10 دقائق؟
وبعد 10 أشهر؟
وبعد 10 سنوات؟
frameworks.output: three-horizon consequence table per option with the chosen option
frameworks.check: each option has an entry at all three horizons and the choice is justified by the longer horizons where they conflict
frameworks.anti_pattern: letting the 10-minute emotion silently win

source_books.title: Playing to Win
source_books.author: A. G. Lafley, Roger L. Martin

questions_en: What is our winning aspiration?
Where will we play, and how will we win there?
What capabilities and management systems must be in place?
questions_ar: ما طموحنا للفوز؟
أين سنلعب، وكيف سنفوز هناك؟
ما القدرات وأنظمة الإدارة التي يجب أن تكون موجودة؟
frameworks.output: five-box strategy cascade (aspiration, where to play, how to win, capabilities, systems)
frameworks.check: all five boxes filled, 'where to play' excludes at least one segment, and capabilities map to 'how to win'
frameworks.anti_pattern: choosing 'everywhere' as where to play

source_books.title: Decide & Deliver
source_books.author: Marcia W. Blenko, Michael C. Mankins, Paul Rogers

questions_en: Who Recommends and who has the D (Decide)?
Who must Agree, who gives Input, and who Performs?
Is there exactly one decider?
questions_ar: من يوصي ومن يملك القرار؟
من يجب أن يوافق، ومن يقدم مدخلات، ومن ينفذ؟
هل هناك صاحب قرار واحد فقط؟
frameworks.output: RAPID role table for each key decision
frameworks.check: every key decision has exactly one D, at least one R, and named P owners
frameworks.anti_pattern: giving 'Agree' veto to so many people that nothing gets decided

source_books.title: Noise
source_books.author: Daniel Kahneman, Olivier Sibony, Cass R. Sunstein

questions_en: Which independent dimensions should the judgement be decomposed into?
Are assessors scoring each dimension independently before discussion?
Is the final holistic judgement delayed until all dimensions are scored?
questions_ar: إلى أي أبعاد مستقلة يجب تفكيك الحكم؟
هل يقيّم المقيّمون كل بعد باستقلال قبل النقاش؟
هل الحكم الشامل النهائي مؤجل حتى تُقيّم كل الأبعاد؟
frameworks.output: assessment sheet of independent dimension scores per assessor and a delayed final judgement
frameworks.check: at least 4 dimensions, at least 2 independent assessors, scores recorded before discussion, and noise (spread) reported
frameworks.anti_pattern: letting one dimension's impression contaminate the others (halo)

questions_en: Which factors multiply to give the quantity we need?
What reasonable bounds can we put on each factor?
What order-of-magnitude result follows, and which factor dominates uncertainty?
questions_ar: ما العوامل التي تتضاعف لتعطي الكمية المطلوبة؟
ما الحدود المعقولة لكل عامل؟
ما النتيجة بمرتبة الحجم، وأي عامل يهيمن على عدم اليقين؟
frameworks.output: factor decomposition with low/high bounds per factor and an order-of-magnitude estimate
frameworks.check: at least 3 factors with bounds, arithmetic shown, and result reported as a range with the dominant factor named
frameworks.anti_pattern: presenting a Fermi estimate as a precise number

questions_en: Imagine it is months later and the project failed: what happened?
Which failure stories are most plausible and most damaging?
What changes to the plan now prevent or detect them?
questions_ar: تخيل أنه بعد أشهر وقد فشل المشروع: ماذا حدث؟
أي قصص الفشل أكثر معقولية وضرراً؟
ما التغييرات على الخطة الآن التي تمنعها أو تكشفها؟
frameworks.output: list of failure stories ranked by likelihood x impact with a mitigation or early-warning signal each
frameworks.check: at least 5 failure stories, top 3 each have a mitigation owner and a detection signal added to the plan
frameworks.anti_pattern: running it as a polite risk list without the vivid 'it already failed' frame, or ignoring the results

book_evidence.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow

source_books.title: Red Team: How to Succeed by Thinking Like the Enemy
source_books.author: Micah Zenko

questions_en: How would a motivated adversary or critic defeat this plan or system?
Which assumptions would they exploit?
What did the independent challenge find, and what changed as a result?
questions_ar: كيف سيهزم خصم أو ناقد متحمس هذه الخطة أو النظام؟
أي افتراضات سيستغلها؟
ماذا وجد التحدي المستقل، وما الذي تغير نتيجة لذلك؟
frameworks.output: red-team findings list with severity, exploited assumption and remediation status
frameworks.check: red team independent of builders, at least 3 findings with severity, and each high finding has a fix or accepted-risk sign-off
frameworks.anti_pattern: red team that is captured by the team it reviews or whose findings are ignored

questions_en: Is this system fragile, robust or antifragile to volatility?
Where does it lose a lot from shocks and gain little?
How can we add optionality so stressors make it stronger?
questions_ar: هل هذا النظام هش أم متين أم مضاد للهشاشة تجاه التقلب؟
أين يخسر كثيراً من الصدمات ويكسب قليلاً؟
كيف نضيف خيارات بحيث تجعله الضغوط أقوى؟
frameworks.output: fragility map of components with the shape of their response to shocks and optionality changes
frameworks.check: each component labelled fragile/robust/antifragile with a stressor example, and at least 2 changes that convert a fragile exposure
frameworks.anti_pattern: confusing antifragility with mere robustness, or inviting unhedged shocks

book_evidence.title: Antifragile: Things That Gain from Disorder

questions_en: What is our best estimate of the requirement (load, cost, time)?
How wrong could that estimate plausibly be?
What buffer do we build in so that being wrong is survivable?
questions_ar: ما أفضل تقدير لدينا للمتطلب (الحمل، التكلفة، الوقت)؟
إلى أي حد قد يكون هذا التقدير خاطئاً بشكل معقول؟
ما الهامش الذي نبنيه بحيث يكون الخطأ قابلاً للتحمل؟
frameworks.output: table of key estimates with error range and the chosen buffer per item
frameworks.check: every critical estimate has an error range and a buffer at least as large as the plausible error, stated numerically
frameworks.anti_pattern: padding everything uniformly so buffers become waste and are consumed by Parkinson's law

book_evidence.title: The Intelligent Investor

questions_en: Which rare, high-impact events would our model not anticipate?
Are we in a domain with fat tails (Extremistan) or thin tails?
How can we limit exposure to negative tails and keep exposure to positive ones?
questions_ar: ما الأحداث النادرة عالية الأثر التي لن يتوقعها نموذجنا؟
هل نحن في مجال ذي ذيول سميكة أم رفيعة؟
كيف نحد من التعرض للذيول السلبية ونحافظ على التعرض للإيجابية؟
frameworks.output: tail-exposure list with domain classification and exposure limits
frameworks.check: domain classified with justification, at least 3 tail events listed, and each negative tail has an exposure cap
frameworks.anti_pattern: pretending to predict specific black swans instead of limiting exposure

book_evidence.title: The Black Swan: The Impact of the Highly Improbable

questions_en: What portion can be kept extremely safe?
What small portion can go into high-upside, capped-downside bets?
Are we avoiding the fragile middle?
questions_ar: ما الجزء الذي يمكن إبقاؤه آمناً جداً؟
ما الجزء الصغير الذي يمكن وضعه في رهانات عالية العائد ومحدودة الخسارة؟
هل نتجنب المنطقة الوسطى الهشة؟
frameworks.output: allocation split between safe core and capped speculative bets, with loss caps
frameworks.check: percentages sum to 100, each speculative bet has a maximum loss, and no allocation sits in the medium-risk middle without reason
frameworks.anti_pattern: labelling a reckless portfolio as a barbell without a truly safe side

book_evidence.title: Antifragile: Things That Gain from Disorder

questions_en: Which biases are most likely here (confirmation, anchoring, sunk cost, overconfidence, availability, groupthink)?
What evidence shows each bias is or is not operating?
What debiasing step addresses each operating bias?
questions_ar: ما التحيزات الأرجح هنا (التأكيد، الارتكاز، التكلفة الغارقة، الثقة المفرطة، الإتاحة، التفكير الجمعي)؟
ما الدليل على أن كل تحيز يعمل أو لا يعمل؟
ما خطوة إزالة التحيز التي تعالج كل تحيز فاعل؟
frameworks.output: bias checklist with present/absent verdict, evidence and a debiasing action for each present bias
frameworks.check: at least 6 biases checked, each verdict cites evidence, and each present bias has a concrete countermeasure
frameworks.anti_pattern: citing biases to dismiss opponents rather than auditing one's own reasoning

book_evidence.title: Die Kunst des klaren Denkens
Thinking, Fast and Slow

source_books.title: The Basics of FMEA
source_books.author: Robin E. McDermott, Raymond J. Mikulak, Michael R. Beauregard

questions_en: How can each component or step fail?
What are the severity, occurrence and detection ratings of each failure mode?
Which highest-risk modes get corrective actions first?
questions_ar: كيف يمكن أن يفشل كل مكون أو خطوة؟
ما تقييمات الخطورة والتكرار والكشف لكل نمط فشل؟
أي الأنماط الأعلى خطراً تحصل على إجراءات تصحيحية أولاً؟
frameworks.output: FMEA table: item, failure mode, effect, S/O/D scores, RPN and corrective action
frameworks.check: every item has at least 1 failure mode, RPN = S x O x D computed, and top RPNs have actions with owners
frameworks.anti_pattern: treating RPN as precise and ignoring high-severity low-RPN modes

questions_en: What can be removed rather than added to improve this?
Which components carry risk without proportional benefit?
What breaks if we remove each candidate?
questions_ar: ما الذي يمكن حذفه بدلاً من إضافته لتحسين هذا؟
أي المكونات تحمل مخاطرة دون فائدة متناسبة؟
ما الذي سينكسر إذا حذفنا كل مرشح؟
frameworks.output: removal list with expected risk reduction and a breakage check per item
frameworks.check: at least 3 removal candidates, each with a breakage test result, and net complexity reduced
frameworks.anti_pattern: removing load-bearing parts without checking why they exist

book_evidence.title: Antifragile: Things That Gain from Disorder

questions_en: What layers of defence stand between hazard and harm?
Where are the holes in each layer (active failures and latent conditions)?
Which holes could line up, and which layer should we strengthen?
questions_ar: ما طبقات الدفاع بين الخطر والضرر؟
أين الثقوب في كل طبقة (إخفاقات نشطة وظروف كامنة)؟
أي الثقوب قد تصطف، وأي طبقة يجب تقويتها؟
frameworks.output: layer diagram listing defences, known holes per layer and aligned-hole scenarios
frameworks.check: at least 3 layers, each with at least 1 identified hole, and at least 1 aligned-hole scenario with a fix
frameworks.anti_pattern: blaming the last person in the chain instead of fixing latent conditions

source_books.title: The Art of the Long View
source_books.author: Peter Schwartz

questions_en: What are the two most critical and uncertain driving forces?
What plausible, distinct scenarios result from their combinations?
Which strategy is robust across scenarios, and what signposts tell us which is unfolding?
questions_ar: ما القوتان الدافعتان الأكثر حرجاً وعدم يقين؟
ما السيناريوهات المعقولة والمتمايزة الناتجة عن تركيباتهما؟
أي استراتيجية تصمد عبر السيناريوهات، وما المؤشرات التي تخبرنا أيها يتحقق؟
frameworks.output: 2x2 scenario set with narratives, implications per scenario and signposts
frameworks.check: exactly 2 axes of critical uncertainty, 4 named scenarios, a robust action list, and at least 1 signpost per scenario
frameworks.anti_pattern: treating one scenario as the forecast and the rest as decoration

questions_en: Which parts are tightly coupled, with little slack or time to intervene?
Where can failures interact in unexpected ways?
How can we loosen coupling or reduce interactive complexity?
questions_ar: أي الأجزاء مقترنة بإحكام، بلا مرونة أو وقت للتدخل؟
أين يمكن أن تتفاعل الإخفاقات بطرق غير متوقعة؟
كيف نخفف الاقتران أو نقلل التعقيد التفاعلي؟
frameworks.output: coupling/complexity map of components with cascade paths and decoupling actions
frameworks.check: each component rated on coupling and complexity, at least 2 cascade paths traced, and at least 1 decoupling change specified
frameworks.anti_pattern: adding more safety mechanisms that themselves add interactive complexity

questions_en: What accumulates in this system (the stocks)?
What inflows and outflows change each stock, and at what rates?
What delays exist between flow changes and stock changes?
questions_ar: ما الذي يتراكم في هذا النظام (المخزونات)؟
ما التدفقات الداخلة والخارجة التي تغير كل مخزون وبأي معدلات؟
ما التأخيرات بين تغير التدفقات وتغير المخزونات؟
frameworks.output: stock-and-flow diagram with named stocks, inflows, outflows, rates and delays
frameworks.check: every stock has at least one inflow and outflow, units are consistent, and at least one delay is quantified
frameworks.anti_pattern: confusing stocks with flows (e.g. treating sign-ups as users)

questions_en: Where could we intervene: parameters, buffers, structure, delays, feedback, information flows, rules, goals or paradigms?
Which interventions are higher on the leverage ladder?
Which high-leverage intervention is feasible now?
questions_ar: أين يمكن أن نتدخل: المعاملات، المخازن، البنية، التأخيرات، التغذية الراجعة، تدفق المعلومات، القواعد، الأهداف أم النماذج الفكرية؟
أي التدخلات أعلى في سلم الرافعة؟
أي تدخل عالي الرافعة ممكن الآن؟
frameworks.output: list of candidate interventions classified by leverage level with feasibility and expected effect
frameworks.check: at least 5 interventions across at least 3 leverage levels, and the chosen one is above 'parameters' or justified
frameworks.anti_pattern: spending all effort tweaking numbers (parameters) while ignoring rules and goals

questions_en: Which reinforcing loops amplify change here?
Which balancing loops resist change or seek a goal?
Which loop currently dominates, and what could shift dominance?
questions_ar: أي الحلقات المعززة تضخم التغيير هنا؟
أي الحلقات الموازنة تقاوم التغيير أو تسعى نحو هدف؟
أي حلقة تهيمن حالياً، وما الذي قد يغير الهيمنة؟
frameworks.output: loop inventory labelled R or B with the variables in each and the currently dominant loop
frameworks.check: at least 1 R and 1 B loop, each loop's polarity check is consistent, and dominance claim cites data
frameworks.anti_pattern: drawing loops without checking link polarities

book_evidence.title: The Fifth Discipline: The Art & Practice of The Learning Organization

questions_en: Does the situation match an archetype (fixes that fail, shifting the burden, limits to growth, tragedy of the commons, escalation, success to the successful)?
What structure produces the recurring behaviour?
What is the archetype's known high-leverage response?
questions_ar: هل يطابق الوضع نموذجاً أصلياً (إصلاحات تفشل، نقل العبء، حدود النمو، مأساة المشاع، التصعيد، النجاح للناجح)؟
ما البنية التي تنتج السلوك المتكرر؟
ما الاستجابة عالية الرافعة المعروفة لهذا النموذج؟
frameworks.output: matched archetype diagram mapped to task variables plus the recommended structural response
frameworks.check: archetype variables mapped one-to-one to real task variables and the response targets a loop, not a symptom
frameworks.anti_pattern: forcing a superficial archetype match with no evidence of the structure

book_evidence.title: The Fifth Discipline: The Art & Practice of The Learning Organization

questions_en: What is the single constraint limiting throughput now?
How can we exploit and subordinate everything else to it?
After elevating it, where does the constraint move?
questions_ar: ما القيد الواحد الذي يحد من الإنتاجية الآن؟
كيف نستغله ونُخضع كل شيء آخر له؟
بعد رفعه، إلى أين ينتقل القيد؟
frameworks.output: constraint identification with throughput measurements and the five focusing steps plan
frameworks.check: constraint chosen from measured queue/throughput data, the plan includes exploit and subordinate steps, and throughput is re-measured after change
frameworks.anti_pattern: optimising non-bottleneck steps, which adds no throughput

book_evidence.title: The Goal

source_books.title: Wardley Maps: Topographical Intelligence in Business
source_books.author: Simon Wardley

questions_en: What user need anchors the map, and what value chain of components serves it?
Where is each component on the evolution axis (genesis, custom, product, commodity)?
What should we build, buy or use as utility given that position?
questions_ar: ما احتياج المستخدم الذي يرسي الخريطة، وما سلسلة القيمة من المكونات التي تخدمه؟
أين يقع كل مكون على محور التطور (نشأة، مخصص، منتج، سلعة)؟
ما الذي يجب أن نبنيه أو نشتريه أو نستخدمه كخدمة بناءً على ذلك؟
frameworks.output: Wardley map: anchored value chain with components positioned on evolution and build/buy/outsource decisions
frameworks.check: anchor is a user need, every component has a dependency link and an evolution stage, and every commodity component is not custom-built without justification
frameworks.anti_pattern: drawing a map without movement or using it as a static architecture diagram

questions_en: Which variables matter and how does each influence the others (+/-)?
Which closed loops and delays exist?
What policy experiments does the diagram suggest?
questions_ar: ما المتغيرات المهمة وكيف يؤثر كل منها على الآخر (+/-)؟
ما الحلقات المغلقة والتأخيرات الموجودة؟
ما تجارب السياسات التي يقترحها المخطط؟
frameworks.output: causal loop diagram (as edge list with polarity and delay marks) and a list of policy experiments
frameworks.check: every edge has polarity, at least 2 closed loops identified, and at least 1 policy experiment linked to a loop
frameworks.anti_pattern: diagramming everything into an unreadable hairball

frameworks.name_en: Product Development Flow and Queueing (Little's Law)

source_books.title: The Principles of Product Development Flow
source_books.author: Donald G. Reinertsen

questions_en: How much work is in progress, and what is the arrival and completion rate?
What does Little's Law (cycle time = WIP / throughput) predict?
Which batch-size or WIP reductions cut cycle time, and what is the cost of delay?
questions_ar: كم العمل الجاري، وما معدل الوصول والإنجاز؟
ماذا يتنبأ قانون ليتل (زمن الدورة = العمل الجاري / الإنتاجية)؟
أي تقليصات في حجم الدفعة أو العمل الجاري تختصر زمن الدورة، وما تكلفة التأخير؟
frameworks.output: queue analysis with WIP, throughput, computed cycle time, cost of delay and batch-size recommendation
frameworks.check: cycle time computed from measured WIP and throughput and compared with observed cycle time; recommendation quantified
frameworks.anti_pattern: maximising utilisation to near 100%, which explodes queues

questions_en: Which units do the primary work (System 1), and how are they coordinated (System 2)?
What provides operational control (3), environmental intelligence (4) and identity/policy (5)?
Which of the five functions is missing or overloaded?
questions_ar: ما الوحدات التي تؤدي العمل الأساسي (النظام 1)، وكيف تُنسَّق (النظام 2)؟
ما الذي يوفر التحكم التشغيلي (3) والاستخبارات البيئية (4) والهوية والسياسة (5)؟
أي الوظائف الخمس مفقودة أو مثقلة؟
frameworks.output: VSM mapping of the organisation or agent system to Systems 1-5 with gaps identified
frameworks.check: all five systems mapped to named roles or components and at least 1 gap with a remedy
frameworks.anti_pattern: using VSM as a rigid org chart rather than a diagnostic of viability

questions_en: Is there a simple version of this system that already works?
What is the smallest working system we can evolve from?
Are we designing a complex system from scratch?
questions_ar: هل توجد نسخة بسيطة من هذا النظام تعمل فعلاً؟
ما أصغر نظام عامل يمكننا التطور منه؟
هل نصمم نظاماً معقداً من الصفر؟
frameworks.output: evolution path starting from a minimal working system with staged increments
frameworks.check: first stage is independently runnable and tested, and each later stage adds one capability with its own check
frameworks.anti_pattern: big-bang rewrites or full-spec designs never run end to end

questions_en: How do current team boundaries and communication paths shape the architecture?
Which team types (stream-aligned, platform, enabling, complicated-subsystem) fit the work?
What interaction modes should teams use?
questions_ar: كيف تشكل حدود الفرق ومسارات التواصل الحالية المعمارية؟
أي أنواع الفرق (موجهة للتدفق، منصة، تمكينية، نظام فرعي معقد) تناسب العمل؟
ما أنماط التفاعل التي يجب أن تستخدمها الفرق؟
frameworks.output: team-to-component ownership map with team types and interaction modes
frameworks.check: every component has exactly one owning team, each team has a type, and cognitive load concerns are noted
frameworks.anti_pattern: reorganising teams without aligning architecture, or ignoring cognitive load

questions_en: What are the steps from request to delivered value?
What is process time versus wait time at each step?
What future-state flow removes the largest waits and handoffs?
questions_ar: ما الخطوات من الطلب إلى القيمة المسلّمة؟
ما زمن المعالجة مقابل زمن الانتظار في كل خطوة؟
ما التدفق المستقبلي الذي يزيل أكبر فترات الانتظار والتسليمات؟
frameworks.output: current-state and future-state value stream maps with process and wait times
frameworks.check: each step has measured process and wait time, flow efficiency computed, and the future state removes at least 1 step or wait
frameworks.anti_pattern: mapping from memory instead of walking the actual process

source_books.title: Competing Against Luck
source_books.author: Clayton M. Christensen, Taddy Hall, Karen Dillon, David S. Duncan

questions_en: What progress is the customer trying to make in a specific circumstance?
What functional, emotional and social dimensions does the job have?
What are they 'hiring' today, and what makes them switch?
questions_ar: ما التقدم الذي يحاول العميل تحقيقه في ظرف محدد؟
ما الأبعاد الوظيفية والعاطفية والاجتماعية للوظيفة؟
ما الذي "يوظفونه" اليوم، وما الذي يدفعهم للتبديل؟
frameworks.output: job statements (when..., I want to..., so I can...) with current solutions and switching forces
frameworks.check: at least 3 job statements grounded in user evidence, each with a current alternative and at least 1 push and 1 pull force
frameworks.anti_pattern: writing jobs as product features or demographic personas

questions_en: Which features are must-haves whose absence causes dissatisfaction?
Which are performance features (more is better)?
Which are delighters users do not expect?
questions_ar: أي الميزات أساسية يسبب غيابها عدم الرضا؟
أيها ميزات أداء (كلما زاد كان أفضل)؟
أيها ميزات مبهرة لا يتوقعها المستخدمون؟
frameworks.output: feature list classified must-be / performance / delighter / indifferent with evidence
frameworks.check: every feature classified, classification based on user responses or cited evidence, and all must-bes included in scope
frameworks.anti_pattern: assuming delighters stay delighters forever (they decay into must-bes)

questions_en: What impact would each idea have on the target metric?
How confident are we in that impact, and why?
How easy is it to implement?
questions_ar: ما الأثر الذي ستحدثه كل فكرة على المقياس المستهدف؟
ما مدى ثقتنا في هذا الأثر ولماذا؟
ما مدى سهولة التنفيذ؟
frameworks.output: ranked experiment backlog with Impact, Confidence, Ease scores and total
frameworks.check: every idea scored on the same scale, confidence references evidence, and the top item is the next experiment
frameworks.anti_pattern: inflating confidence scores without evidence

questions_en: Which requirements are Must have for this release?
Which are Should have and Could have?
What Won't we do this time?
questions_ar: ما المتطلبات التي يجب توفرها في هذا الإصدار؟
أيها ينبغي توفرها وأيها يمكن توفرها؟
ما الذي لن نفعله هذه المرة؟
frameworks.output: requirements list labelled Must/Should/Could/Won't for a defined timebox
frameworks.check: every requirement labelled, Musts fit within the timebox estimate, and Won't list is non-empty
frameworks.anti_pattern: labelling almost everything Must

questions_en: What desired outcome sits at the root?
Which customer opportunities (needs, pains, desires) could drive it?
Which solutions and assumption tests branch from the chosen opportunity?
questions_ar: ما النتيجة المرغوبة في الجذر؟
ما فرص العملاء (الاحتياجات، الآلام، الرغبات) التي قد تقودها؟
ما الحلول واختبارات الافتراضات المتفرعة من الفرصة المختارة؟
frameworks.output: opportunity solution tree: outcome -> opportunities -> solutions -> assumption tests
frameworks.check: one measurable outcome, at least 3 opportunities from research, at least 3 solutions for the target opportunity, each with an assumption test
frameworks.anti_pattern: jumping from outcome straight to a single favourite solution

questions_en: What are the top 3 problems and customer segments?
What is the unique value proposition, solution and unfair advantage?
What are channels, revenue streams, cost structure and key metrics?
questions_ar: ما أهم 3 مشكلات وشرائح العملاء؟
ما عرض القيمة الفريد والحل والميزة غير القابلة للنسخ؟
ما القنوات ومصادر الإيراد وهيكل التكاليف والمقاييس الرئيسية؟
frameworks.output: one-page lean canvas with all 9 boxes and the riskiest box flagged
frameworks.check: all 9 boxes filled, the riskiest assumption identified, and a test planned for it
frameworks.anti_pattern: filling the canvas once and treating it as validated

questions_en: What is the leap-of-faith assumption we need to test?
What is the smallest thing we can build to measure it?
What result will make us persevere or pivot?
questions_ar: ما الافتراض الجوهري الذي نحتاج لاختباره؟
ما أصغر شيء يمكن بناؤه لقياسه؟
ما النتيجة التي ستجعلنا نستمر أو نغير الاتجاه؟
frameworks.output: experiment card: hypothesis, build, metric, success threshold, decision rule, and result
frameworks.check: threshold set before running, metric measured, and a persevere/pivot decision recorded
frameworks.anti_pattern: measuring vanity metrics or setting thresholds after seeing results

book_evidence.title: The Lean Startup‎

questions_en: What is the key learning goal of the first version?
What is the minimum that delivers that learning with real users?
What is deliberately excluded?
questions_ar: ما هدف التعلم الأساسي للنسخة الأولى؟
ما الحد الأدنى الذي يحقق هذا التعلم مع مستخدمين حقيقيين؟
ما المستبعد عمداً؟
frameworks.output: MVP spec: learning goal, included features, excluded features, success metric
frameworks.check: one learning goal, every included feature tied to it, excluded list non-empty, and metric measurable within the first release
frameworks.anti_pattern: shipping a buggy half-product with no learning goal, or gold-plating the MVP

book_evidence.title: The Lean Startup‎

questions_en: What single metric best captures the core value customers get?
Does it predict long-term revenue and retention?
Which input metrics drive it?
questions_ar: ما المقياس الواحد الذي يلتقط أفضل القيمة الجوهرية التي يحصل عليها العملاء؟
هل يتنبأ بالإيراد والاحتفاظ على المدى الطويل؟
ما مقاييس المدخلات التي تقوده؟
frameworks.output: North Star metric definition with formula, rationale and 3-5 input metrics
frameworks.check: metric has an exact formula and time window, reflects delivered customer value (not vanity), and each input metric is actionable by a team
frameworks.anti_pattern: choosing a revenue or vanity metric that does not reflect customer value

questions_en: How are users acquired and activated?
What are retention and referral rates?
Where does revenue come from, and which stage leaks most?
questions_ar: كيف يُكتسب المستخدمون ويُفعّلون؟
ما معدلات الاحتفاظ والإحالة؟
من أين يأتي الإيراد، وأي مرحلة تتسرب أكثر؟
frameworks.output: funnel table with one defined metric and current value per AARRR stage and the leakiest stage
frameworks.check: all 5 stages have a precise definition and a number, conversion between stages computed, and one stage chosen for focus
frameworks.anti_pattern: optimising acquisition while retention leaks

questions_en: What external and internal triggers prompt use?
What is the simplest action, and what variable reward follows?
What investment do users make that improves the next cycle?
questions_ar: ما المحفزات الخارجية والداخلية التي تدفع للاستخدام؟
ما أبسط فعل، وما المكافأة المتغيرة التي تتبعه؟
ما الاستثمار الذي يقدمه المستخدم ويحسن الدورة التالية؟
frameworks.output: hook canvas: trigger, action, variable reward, investment, plus an ethics check
frameworks.check: all four phases defined, the action is measurable, and the manipulation-matrix ethics check is answered
frameworks.anti_pattern: building compulsive loops that do not improve users' lives

source_books.title: Value Proposition Design
source_books.author: Alexander Osterwalder, Yves Pigneur, Gregory Bernarda, Alan Smith

questions_en: What jobs, pains and gains does the customer segment have?
Which products, pain relievers and gain creators do we offer?
Where is the fit, and where are the gaps?
questions_ar: ما الوظائف والآلام والمكاسب لدى شريحة العملاء؟
ما المنتجات ومخففات الألم وصانعات المكاسب التي نقدمها؟
أين التوافق وأين الفجوات؟
frameworks.output: value proposition canvas with customer profile, value map and fit assessment
frameworks.check: at least 3 items per profile section, every pain reliever maps to a listed pain, and gaps are listed
frameworks.anti_pattern: filling the customer profile from internal assumptions without customer evidence

questions_en: Who are the customer segments, what is the value proposition, and through which channels and relationships?
What are the revenue streams and cost structure?
Which key resources, activities and partners make it work?
questions_ar: من شرائح العملاء، وما عرض القيمة، وعبر أي قنوات وعلاقات؟
ما مصادر الإيراد وهيكل التكاليف؟
ما الموارد والأنشطة والشركاء الرئيسيون الذين يجعلونه يعمل؟
frameworks.output: nine-block business model canvas with consistency notes
frameworks.check: all 9 blocks filled, revenue and cost blocks reference the same segments, and at least 1 untested assumption flagged
frameworks.anti_pattern: listing everything the company does instead of the model's essentials

book_evidence.title: Business Model Generation

frameworks.name_ar: استراتيجية المحيط الأزرق (شبكة الحذف، التقليل، الرفع، الابتكار)
questions_en: Which factors the industry competes on should be eliminated or reduced?
Which should be raised well above standard?
What new factors should be created?
questions_ar: أي العوامل التي تتنافس عليها الصناعة يجب حذفها أو تقليلها؟
أيها يجب رفعه فوق المعيار بكثير؟
ما العوامل الجديدة التي يجب ابتكارها؟
frameworks.output: ERRC grid and a strategy canvas comparing our value curve to competitors
frameworks.check: at least 1 entry in each of the 4 ERRC boxes and a value curve that visibly diverges from at least 2 competitors
frameworks.anti_pattern: adding 'create' items without eliminating anything, which only raises cost

book_evidence.title: Blue Ocean Strategy: How to Create Uncontested Market Space and Make Competition Irrelevant

questions_en: Where on the adoption lifecycle are our current users?
Which single beachhead niche of pragmatists can we dominate?
What whole product does that niche need?
questions_ar: أين يقع مستخدمونا الحاليون في دورة التبني؟
ما الشريحة الواحدة (رأس الجسر) من البراغماتيين التي يمكننا السيطرة عليها؟
ما المنتج الكامل الذي تحتاجه هذه الشريحة؟
frameworks.output: beachhead segment definition with whole-product checklist and reference customers plan
frameworks.check: exactly one beachhead named with size estimate, whole-product gaps listed, and at least 1 reference customer target
frameworks.anti_pattern: targeting several mainstream segments at once

book_evidence.title: Crossing the Chasm: Marketing and Selling High-Tech Products to Mainstream Customers

questions_en: Are mainstream customers overserved by incumbents?
Is there a low-end or new-market foothold incumbents ignore?
Is our trajectory improving fast enough to move upmarket?
questions_ar: هل يحصل العملاء الرئيسيون على أكثر مما يحتاجون من الشركات المهيمنة؟
هل توجد نقطة دخول من الطرف المنخفض أو سوق جديد يتجاهلها المهيمنون؟
هل يتحسن مسارنا بسرعة كافية للصعود نحو السوق الرئيسي؟
frameworks.output: disruption assessment: foothold type, overserved evidence, performance trajectory and incumbent response
frameworks.check: foothold classified low-end or new-market with evidence, and trajectory compared to mainstream needs over time
frameworks.anti_pattern: calling any successful new product 'disruptive'

book_evidence.title: The Innovator's Dilemma: The Revolutionary Book that Will Change the Way You Do Business (Collins Business Essentials)

questions_en: What did we learn by empathising with real users?
How do we define the problem from their point of view?
Which ideas do we prototype and test with them?
questions_ar: ماذا تعلمنا من التعاطف مع مستخدمين حقيقيين؟
كيف نعرّف المشكلة من وجهة نظرهم؟
أي الأفكار نصنع لها نماذج ونختبرها معهم؟
frameworks.output: empathy findings, point-of-view statement, prototypes and test results
frameworks.check: at least 3 user observations, POV names user + need + insight, and at least 1 prototype tested with users
frameworks.anti_pattern: running workshops with sticky notes but no real users

source_books.title: Sprint
source_books.author: Jake Knapp, John Zeratsky, Braden Kowitz

questions_en: What long-term goal and sprint questions frame the week?
Which solution does the decider choose to prototype?
What did five customer tests reveal?
questions_ar: ما الهدف بعيد المدى وأسئلة السبرنت التي تؤطر الأسبوع؟
أي حل يختاره صاحب القرار لعمل نموذج له؟
ماذا كشفت خمسة اختبارات مع العملاء؟
frameworks.output: five-day sprint record: map, sketches, decision, realistic prototype, test findings
frameworks.check: sprint questions written, one decider named, prototype built, and findings from 5 user tests tallied against sprint questions
frameworks.anti_pattern: skipping the user tests and treating the prototype as validated

questions_en: Are we asking about their life and past behaviour rather than our idea?
What specifics did they actually do, spend or try?
What commitment or advancement did they offer?
questions_ar: هل نسأل عن حياتهم وسلوكهم السابق بدلاً من فكرتنا؟
ما التفاصيل التي فعلوها أو أنفقوها أو جربوها فعلاً؟
ما الالتزام أو الخطوة المتقدمة التي قدموها؟
frameworks.output: interview script of past-behaviour questions and notes separating facts, compliments and commitments
frameworks.check: no question asks for opinions about the idea, notes tag each item fact/compliment/commitment, and at least 1 commitment is sought
frameworks.anti_pattern: counting compliments and hypothetical 'I would buy it' as validation

questions_en: Will customers buy or choose it (value risk)?
Can users figure out how to use it (usability risk)?
Can we build it (feasibility risk), and does it work for the business (viability risk)?
questions_ar: هل سيشتريه العملاء أو يختارونه (مخاطرة القيمة)؟
هل يستطيع المستخدمون معرفة كيفية استخدامه (مخاطرة سهولة الاستخدام)؟
هل يمكننا بناؤه (مخاطرة الجدوى التقنية)، وهل يناسب العمل (مخاطرة الجدوى التجارية)؟
frameworks.output: risk table for the four risks with evidence level and a discovery test for each high risk
frameworks.check: all 4 risks rated with evidence, and each risk rated high has a prototype or test before build
frameworks.anti_pattern: addressing only feasibility because engineers are in the room

questions_en: What is the user's journey as a sequence of activities (the backbone)?
Which stories sit under each activity?
Which horizontal slice forms the first releasable outcome?
questions_ar: ما رحلة المستخدم كسلسلة أنشطة (العمود الفقري)؟
ما القصص الواقعة تحت كل نشاط؟
أي شريحة أفقية تشكل أول نتيجة قابلة للإصدار؟
frameworks.output: story map with backbone activities, stories beneath, and release slices
frameworks.check: backbone covers the journey end to end, every story sits under an activity, and slice 1 spans all backbone activities
frameworks.anti_pattern: a flat backlog in story-map clothing with no end-to-end first slice

questions_en: Have we tested willingness to pay before building?
Which segments value which features differently?
What packaging and pricing model (tiers, usage, bundles) follows?
questions_ar: هل اختبرنا الاستعداد للدفع قبل البناء؟
أي الشرائح تقدّر أي الميزات بشكل مختلف؟
ما نموذج التغليف والتسعير (باقات، استخدام، حزم) الناتج؟
frameworks.output: willingness-to-pay findings by segment with proposed packages and price points
frameworks.check: WTP data from at least 1 method (interviews, van Westendorp, conjoint) per segment, and each package maps to a segment
frameworks.anti_pattern: designing the product first and bolting on a price at launch

questions_en: Which specific sub-skill sits just beyond current ability?
What well-defined practice task with immediate feedback targets it?
How will we measure improvement between sessions?
questions_ar: ما المهارة الفرعية المحددة التي تقع مباشرة خارج القدرة الحالية؟
ما مهمة التمرين المحددة ذات التغذية الراجعة الفورية التي تستهدفها؟
كيف سنقيس التحسن بين الجلسات؟
frameworks.output: practice plan with targeted sub-skills, drills, feedback source and progress metric
frameworks.check: each drill names one sub-skill, a feedback source and a baseline measurement; progress recorded over at least 2 sessions
frameworks.anti_pattern: mindless repetition in the comfort zone

questions_en: Can we explain the concept in plain words to a newcomer?
Where does our explanation break down or rely on jargon?
What do we need to relearn to fill those gaps?
questions_ar: هل نستطيع شرح المفهوم بكلمات بسيطة لمبتدئ؟
أين ينهار شرحنا أو يعتمد على المصطلحات؟
ما الذي نحتاج لإعادة تعلمه لسد هذه الفجوات؟
frameworks.output: plain-language explanation with marked gaps and the revised explanation after filling them
frameworks.check: explanation avoids undefined jargon, at least 1 gap identified and fixed, and a newcomer or checker can restate it correctly
frameworks.anti_pattern: oversimplifying until the explanation becomes wrong

source_books.title: Make It Stick
source_books.author: Peter C. Brown, Henry L. Roediger III, Mark A. McDaniel

questions_en: What items must be retained long term?
What review schedule with increasing intervals fits the deadline?
How do we track which items are failing?
questions_ar: ما العناصر التي يجب الاحتفاظ بها على المدى الطويل؟
ما جدول المراجعة بفترات متزايدة الذي يناسب الموعد النهائي؟
كيف نتتبع العناصر التي يتم نسيانها؟
frameworks.output: item deck with an expanding review schedule and a recall log
frameworks.check: each item has a scheduled next review, intervals increase after successful recall, and recall rate is logged
frameworks.anti_pattern: cramming massed reviews the night before

source_books.title: Make It Stick
source_books.author: Peter C. Brown, Henry L. Roediger III, Mark A. McDaniel

questions_en: How can learners recall from memory instead of rereading?
How can we mix problem types instead of blocking them?
What low-stakes quizzes check retention?
questions_ar: كيف يسترجع المتعلمون من الذاكرة بدلاً من إعادة القراءة؟
كيف نمزج أنواع المسائل بدلاً من تجميعها؟
ما الاختبارات منخفضة المخاطر التي تتحقق من الاحتفاظ؟
frameworks.output: learning plan with retrieval quizzes and an interleaved practice set
frameworks.check: at least 1 retrieval activity per topic, practice set mixes at least 3 problem types, and quiz scores are recorded
frameworks.anti_pattern: using rereading and highlighting as the main study method

questions_en: What did we intend to happen?
What actually happened?
Why was there a difference, and what will we sustain or change?
questions_ar: ما الذي كنا ننوي حدوثه؟
ما الذي حدث فعلاً؟
لماذا وُجد الفرق، وما الذي سنحافظ عليه أو نغيره؟
frameworks.output: AAR record: intent, actual, gap causes, sustain list, improve list with owners
frameworks.check: intent and actual stated factually, at least 1 gap cause, and every improve item has an owner and a date
frameworks.anti_pattern: turning it into blame or a ritual whose actions are never followed up

source_books.title: Organizational Learning: A Theory of Action Perspective
source_books.author: Chris Argyris, Donald A. Schon

questions_en: What single-loop correction (changing actions) have we tried?
Which governing variables, goals or norms produced the error?
What change to those governing variables would prevent recurrence?
questions_ar: ما التصحيح أحادي الحلقة (تغيير الأفعال) الذي جربناه؟
ما المتغيرات الحاكمة أو الأهداف أو الأعراف التي أنتجت الخطأ؟
ما التغيير في هذه المتغيرات الحاكمة الذي سيمنع التكرار؟
frameworks.output: table of errors with single-loop fix, underlying governing variable and proposed double-loop change
frameworks.check: each error has both levels stated and at least 1 governing variable is explicitly revised
frameworks.anti_pattern: endlessly questioning goals while basic execution fixes are needed

questions_en: What concrete experience did the learner have?
What reflective observation and abstract conceptualisation follow?
What active experimentation tests the new concept?
questions_ar: ما التجربة الملموسة التي مر بها المتعلم؟
ما الملاحظة التأملية والتصور المجرد اللذان يليانها؟
ما التجريب النشط الذي يختبر المفهوم الجديد؟
frameworks.output: four-stage learning design or record: experience, reflection, concept, experiment
frameworks.check: all four stages present in order, the concept is stated as a rule, and the experiment tests that rule
frameworks.anti_pattern: skipping reflection and conceptualisation, so experience never becomes learning

questions_en: Is failure data being captured systematically and openly?
What does each failure reveal about the system?
How are lessons propagated so the same failure cannot recur?
questions_ar: هل تُجمع بيانات الفشل بشكل منهجي ومفتوح؟
ماذا يكشف كل فشل عن النظام؟
كيف تُنشر الدروس بحيث لا يتكرر الفشل نفسه؟
