frameworks.output: failure log with system-level lesson and the propagated fix for each entry
frameworks.check: every failure has a system lesson (not a person), a fix applied to process or tooling, and a recurrence check
frameworks.anti_pattern: punishing reporters so failures go hidden

questions_en: What is the single governing message, stated first?
What 3-5 key supporting points, grouped MECE, back it?
Does the introduction follow situation-complication-question?
questions_ar: ما الرسالة الحاكمة الواحدة التي تُذكر أولاً؟
ما النقاط الداعمة الرئيسية (3-5) المجمعة بشكل متنافٍ وشامل التي تسندها؟
هل تتبع المقدمة تسلسل الموقف ثم التعقيد ثم السؤال؟
frameworks.output: answer-first document outline: governing thought, key line, supporting evidence, SCQ intro
frameworks.check: governing thought in the first 2 sentences, 3-5 supporting points with no overlap, each point backed by evidence
frameworks.anti_pattern: burying the conclusion at the end after a chronological narrative

questions_en: Is the message Simple and Unexpected?
Is it Concrete and Credible?
Does it carry Emotion and a Story?
questions_ar: هل الرسالة بسيطة وغير متوقعة؟
هل هي ملموسة وموثوقة؟
هل تحمل عاطفة وقصة؟
frameworks.output: revised message with a score and improvement note for each of the six principles
frameworks.check: all six principles scored, at least 1 concrete example and 1 credibility detail present, and the core fits in one sentence
frameworks.anti_pattern: forcing all six into a short message until it becomes gimmicky

book_evidence.title: Made to Stick: Why Some Ideas Survive and Others Die

questions_en: Who is the hero (customer), what do they want, and what problem stands in the way?
How does the brand act as guide with empathy, authority and a plan?
What call to action, and what success and failure are at stake?
questions_ar: من البطل (العميل)، وماذا يريد، وما المشكلة التي تعترضه؟
كيف تؤدي العلامة دور المرشد بالتعاطف والسلطة وخطة واضحة؟
ما الدعوة للعمل، وما النجاح والفشل المترتبان؟
frameworks.output: BrandScript with the seven elements and a homepage/headline draft derived from it
frameworks.check: all 7 elements filled, customer is the hero (not the brand), and a single clear call to action appears
frameworks.anti_pattern: making the brand the hero of the story

questions_en: What would the launch press release say about the customer benefit?
What external FAQs would customers ask?
What internal FAQs about cost, feasibility and risk must be answered?
questions_ar: ماذا سيقول البيان الصحفي للإطلاق عن فائدة العميل؟
ما الأسئلة الخارجية التي سيطرحها العملاء؟
ما الأسئلة الداخلية عن التكلفة والجدوى والمخاطر التي يجب الإجابة عنها؟
frameworks.output: one-page press release plus external and internal FAQ
frameworks.check: press release names customer, problem and benefit in the first paragraph, at least 5 external and 5 internal FAQs answered
frameworks.anti_pattern: writing marketing fluff that hides unresolved hard questions

frameworks.name_en: Presentation Sparkline (What Is vs What Could Be)
frameworks.name_ar: خط العرض (ما هو كائن مقابل ما يمكن أن يكون)
questions_en: What is the current reality (what is) for the audience?
What is the better future (what could be)?
How does the talk alternate between them and end with a call to action and the new bliss?
questions_ar: ما الواقع الحالي (ما هو كائن) بالنسبة للجمهور؟
ما المستقبل الأفضل (ما يمكن أن يكون)؟
كيف يتناوب العرض بينهما وينتهي بدعوة للعمل وحالة النعيم الجديدة؟
frameworks.output: talk outline mapped on the sparkline with alternating is/could-be beats and a call to action
frameworks.check: at least 3 is/could-be alternations, a clear turning point, and an explicit call to action
frameworks.anti_pattern: making the presenter the hero instead of the audience

questions_en: Why does this exist, beyond making money?
How do we do it differently?
What exactly do we offer?
questions_ar: لماذا يوجد هذا، بعيداً عن جني المال؟
كيف نفعله بشكل مختلف؟
ماذا نقدم بالضبط؟
frameworks.output: why/how/what statement set used to order a message from purpose to offer
frameworks.check: one why sentence free of product features, 2-3 how differentiators, a concrete what, and the message follows that order
frameworks.anti_pattern: inventing a lofty why that actions and product contradict

book_evidence.title: Start with Why: How Great Leaders Inspire Everyone to Take Action

questions_en: What qualitative, inspiring objective matters most this period?
Which 2-5 measurable key results prove it was achieved?
How are progress check-ins and scoring done?
questions_ar: ما الهدف النوعي الملهم الأهم في هذه الفترة؟
ما النتائج الرئيسية القابلة للقياس (2-5) التي تثبت تحققه؟
كيف تتم متابعة التقدم والتقييم؟
frameworks.output: OKR set: objective, 2-5 key results with baseline and target, check-in cadence
frameworks.check: each key result is a number with baseline, target and date, none is a task, and a scoring method is stated
frameworks.anti_pattern: writing key results as task lists, or setting too many objectives

source_books.title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
source_books.author: Stephen R. Covey

questions_en: Which tasks are both urgent and important (do now)?
Which are important but not urgent (schedule)?
Which are urgent but not important (delegate) or neither (drop)?
questions_ar: أي المهام عاجلة ومهمة معاً (نفّذ الآن)؟
أيها مهمة غير عاجلة (جدولها)؟
أيها عاجلة غير مهمة (فوّضها) أو لا هذا ولا ذاك (احذفها)؟
frameworks.output: task list sorted into the four quadrants with actions and dates
frameworks.check: every task in exactly one quadrant, quadrant-2 items have scheduled dates, and drop list is non-empty or justified
frameworks.anti_pattern: living in quadrant 1 firefighting and never scheduling quadrant 2

book_evidence.title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People

questions_en: Which critical steps are easy to forget under pressure?
Is it a do-confirm or read-do checklist, and where are the pause points?
Is it short enough (about 5-9 items per pause point) to actually be used?
questions_ar: ما الخطوات الحرجة التي يسهل نسيانها تحت الضغط؟
هل هي قائمة نفّذ-ثم-أكّد أم اقرأ-ثم-نفّذ، وأين نقاط التوقف؟
هل هي قصيرة بما يكفي (نحو 5-9 بنود لكل نقطة توقف) لتُستخدم فعلاً؟
frameworks.output: short checklist with pause points, type, and items that each prevent a known failure
frameworks.check: each pause point has at most 9 items, each item is a verifiable action, and the list was tested in a real run
frameworks.anti_pattern: writing long checklists of obvious steps that people stop reading

book_evidence.title: The Checklist Manifesto: How to Get Things Right

source_books.title: Kanban: Successful Evolutionary Change for Your Technology Business
source_books.author: David J. Anderson

questions_en: What are the columns of the real workflow?
What WIP limit fits each column?
What blockers and cycle times does the board reveal?
questions_ar: ما أعمدة سير العمل الفعلي؟
ما حد العمل الجاري المناسب لكل عمود؟
ما العوائق وأزمنة الدورة التي تكشفها اللوحة؟
frameworks.output: kanban board definition with columns, WIP limits, policies and cycle-time metrics
frameworks.check: every in-progress column has a numeric WIP limit, explicit done-policy per column, and cycle time tracked for completed items
frameworks.anti_pattern: drawing a board without WIP limits, which makes it just a to-do list
